title: On additive complements in natural numbers
summary: We prove that for additive complements $A$ and $B$, if $$ \limsup_{x\to+\infty}\frac{A(x)B(x)}{x}<\frac43, $$ then $$ A(x)B(x)-x\rightarrow+\infty\qquad(x\to+\infty). $$ This improves the earlier upper bound $3-\sqrt{3}$ due to Fang and Chen.
